description: Knowledge graph node. Substrate-native KG layer per ADR-2605190900. A node is a typed, content-addressed entity (ADR, module, lexicon, L2 contract, DNS record, actor cell, capability, institution, etc.). Edges connecting nodes use com.etzhayyim.kg.edge.

nodeId.description: Stable identifier for the node. Examples: at-uri (at://did:plc:.../com.etzhayyim.kg.node/<rkey>), did (did:web:etzhayyim.com), urn (urn:adr:2605190900), http(s) URL, or app-defined token (e.g. 'adr:2605190900', 'module:40-engine/kotoba/crates/kotoba-kotodama').

nodeType.description: Type token or IRI. Conventional short tokens: 'adr', 'module', 'lexicon', 'l2-contract', 'dns-record', 'actor-cell', 'capability', 'institution', 'person', 'organization'. Full IRIs allowed for inter-graph alignment.

summary.description: Optional short prose description of the node.

payload.description: Optional structured payload. Prefer application/cbor (IPLD DAG-CBOR) for content-addressed linkage; application/json or application/ld+json acceptable for simpler cases. The blob CID is the natural content address of the payload.

source.description: Projection source. Examples: 'deps.toml', 'adr-frontmatter', 'lexicon-refs', 'module-manifest', 'manual'. The kg-projector sets this automatically; manually-authored nodes use 'manual'.
